collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official Command Code GOAT plan page and pricing/limits page (English) around 10:35 Beijing time / 02:35Z on 2026-10-20. RSC payload (modelScope and planScope), credits table (Every model / New models) and the pricing-limits free-deal wording. One new paid model observed, one new free limited-time variant observed. Research-only — no adopted row generated.
scope: Command Code GOAT official catalog only. New paid model 'MiniMax M3.1 Flash' (slug minimax-m3-1-flash) observed in the New models table, plus a free limited-time variant 'MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free' (slug minimax-m3-1-flash-free) with a deal window. No leaderboard/score data, no shared-pool change, no other GOAT row changes, no adopted.csv row.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted; no command_code_goat × minimax-m3.1-flash row in adopted.csv yet — adding one requires a COMMAND_CODE_GOAT_MODELS entry in scripts/build_adopted.py, left to maintainer review
